stories.title: Harvard University data breach exposed info of 851,000 accounts
stories.summary: Hackers who breached Harvard University's Alumni Affairs and Development systems in November 2025 stole data linked to more than 850,000 unique email addresses, according to breach notification service Have I Been Pwned.

Video investigation October 24 protests: How did police respond to the far right?
stories.summary: At nationwide protests on Saturday, October 24, French far-right activists targeted civilians protesting, with little response from the riot police, a 'Le Monde' investigation has found.

stories.title: California decides whether to tax billionaires, a highly-anticipated vote amid rising inequality
stories.summary: In the US, debates over taxing wealth arise when the accumulation of riches becomes exorbitant. Voters in the Golden State will decide on Tuesday on an unprecedented 5% wealth tax targeting billionaires.

stories.title: “No”: reassured after Vacherot, Djokovic plays down Turin and takes it match by match
stories.summary: Asked whether the ATP Finals were his main drive in Paris, the Serbian replied with a simple “No” after beating Valentin Vacherot 6-7 (5), 7-5, 6-1. His goal: winning every match, starting with qualifier Rinky Hijikata.

stories.title: Djokovic keeps alive bid to squeeze into ATP Finals
stories.summary: Novak Djokovic keeps alive his last-ditch bid to qualify for this year's ATP Finals by grinding out a first-round victory at the Paris Masters.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
